notes.title: March 11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588254/3bd55a76a68ca28329b7366168d6b0020fb2921c.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Completely removed the slow motion effect that triggered every time you kill an enemy.
[*] The game scene has been completely revamped with new graphics and lighting.
[*] Added Apple Silicon support for macOS users.
[/list]

notes.title: July 3 Patch Notes
notes.content: The game enters slow motion mode only if the killed enemy took 5 or more shots to kill with the currently selected weapon now, making the initial slime enemies not trigger it. The whole kill-slow-motion effect is planned to be toggle-able in the future.

notes.title: Feb. 16 Patch Notes
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the aiming and firing input would be taken away from the player in the 12th chapter of the endless mode (Thank you @UTR_reviews).

notes.title: Jan. 13 Patch Notes
notes.content: Fixed the main menu discord button having a broken discord invitation link.

notes.title: Jan. 8 Patch Notes
notes.content: - Fixed a bug related to one of the achievements, "game is starting in an unresponsive state".
